_meta.rule: No two lanes may own the same directory. Each agent reads this file to verify file ownership before writing. If a target file is not in your lane, you cannot touch it.

CONTROL.description: Execution control layer. Maintained by the coordinating agent only. No feature agents write here.

LANE_THEME.description: Design token system and runtime theme injection. Foundation layer — all other lanes depend on tokens being correct before styling anything.

src/main.tsx.note: LANE_THEME owns main.tsx for P2-S2 (provider stack). LANE_AUTH requires a coordinated handoff for P4-S2 (AuthProvider insertion). Agents must not edit main.tsx simultaneously. The second agent to touch main.tsx must read the current file state before editing.

LANE_SHELL.description: App-shell layout architecture. Replaces the website-model Shell/Navbar/Footer with GlobalSurface/GlobalHeader/BottomNav/AnimatedPortalShell.

src/App.tsx.note: LANE_SHELL owns App.tsx for P3-S5 (route restructure). LANE_COMPONENTS requires access for P6-S4 (root overlay). LANE_ROUTING requires access for P7-S1, P7-S2, P7-S3. Access is sequential — each subsequent lane must read the current App.tsx before editing.

LANE_AUTH.description: Authentication and multi-role system. Introduces authStore, AuthProvider, ProtectedRoute, and role type definitions.

src/main.tsx.note: LANE_AUTH inserts AuthProvider into the provider stack during P4-S2. Must read current main.tsx state (written by LANE_THEME) before editing. Must not remove or reorder existing providers.

src/stores/authStore.ts.note: Owned exclusively by LANE_AUTH. LANE_STATE must not write to this file. LANE_STATE reads authStore for uiStore integration only.

LANE_STATE.description: Global state architecture. Adds React Query for server state, uiStore for global UI control, and cart store persistence.

src/main.tsx.note: LANE_STATE inserts QueryClientProvider into the provider stack during P5-S1. Must read current main.tsx state before editing. Must not remove AuthProvider or ThemeProvider.

LANE_COMPONENTS.description: UI component system. Replaces GlassCard with ModuleShell/VelariShell, migrates all components, moves overlay to root level.

src/App.tsx.note: LANE_COMPONENTS writes to App.tsx only for P6-S4 (root-level Cart overlay). Must read current App.tsx state before editing. Must preserve all routing structure from LANE_SHELL's P3-S5 work.

LANE_ROUTING.description: Routing performance and resilience. Adds lazy loading, Suspense fallbacks, and error boundaries.

src/App.tsx.note: LANE_ROUTING writes to App.tsx for P7-S1 (lazy imports), P7-S2 (Suspense), P7-S3 (ErrorBoundary). Must read current App.tsx state. Must preserve routing structure, shell wrappers, and root overlay. This is the final agent to touch App.tsx.

src/main.tsx.rule: Read before write. Never remove what a previous lane added.

src/App.tsx.rule: Read before write. Never remove what a previous lane added.

overlap_violations.description: Any agent writing to a directory or file not in its owned_files list is a lane violation. Lane violations invalidate the segment and require re-execution.
overlap_violations.enforcement: Before writing any file, agent must confirm file path exists in lanes.json owned_files for its lane. If not listed, agent must halt and flag to coordinator.
